title: Fortitude — Internal Recruiting Platform
goal: Streamline requisition → pipeline → offer and increase recruiter effectiveness.
summary: Comprehensive redesign of enterprise recruiting workflow, reducing time-to-hire while improving SLA adherence and candidate experience across complex organizational structures.

roleScope.scope: Service design, workflow redesign, design system, research/testing

goalConstraints: Shorten requisition → pipeline → offer cycle time and clarify ownership while honoring privacy/security constraints on candidate data and maintaining compliance with enterprise security protocols.

cards.title: Research Plan
cards.body:
Roll-up of roles, questions, and measures.
Ops notes: Comprehensive stakeholder analysis across 15 departments

cards.title: Funnel Analysis
cards.body:
Pinpointed bottlenecks for prioritization.
Data source: 18-month historical recruiting data analysis

insights.title: Critical Bottlenecks
insights.body: 65% of delays occurred in interview scheduling and feedback collection phases

insights.title: Role Confusion
insights.body: Unclear ownership at stage transitions led to 40% of process stalls

insights.title: Timing Issues
insights.body: Average 8.5 days between interview rounds due to coordination failures

workflow.intro: We codified "what's next" by role, standardized stage gates, and added signal-based prioritization (candidate strength, SLA timers, role urgency).

cards.title: Stage Definitions + SLA Matrix
cards.body:
Ownership and timers.
Shared expectations reduce handoffs and stalls.
Review cadence: Weekly cross-functional alignment meetings

cards.title: Stage Gates / Ownership / Timers / Signals
cards.body: Clear entry/exit criteria; defined responsibilities for recruiters and hiring managers; automated SLA alerts; dynamic prioritization.

ia.intro: Pipeline views are tailored to recruiters and hiring managers; intake is structured for completeness; the offer path is auditable.

prototypes.title: Scheduling Assistant (Lo-Fi)
prototypes.body:
Resolve calendar conflicts; fewer no-shows; smoother coordination.
Usability notes: 85% task completion rate in initial testing

prototypes.title: Pipeline (Hi-Fi)
prototypes.body:
Stages, signals, actions. Signals drive prioritization and decisions.
Token reference: Design system v2.1 implementation

prototypes.title: Accessibility First
prototypes.body: WCAG 2.1 AA with keyboard navigation and screen reader support

ops.title: Acceptance Criteria Snapshot
ops.body:
Definition of done.
Limits rework and elevates release quality.
Gate owners: Cross-functional review team with defined approval authority

ops.title: Quality Gates / Iterative Testing / Metrics / Alignment
ops.body: Rigorous checkpoints at each milestone; weekly usability sessions; real-time performance monitoring; bi-weekly decision reviews with executive stakeholders.
